title: QuickBZ
description: Adds hotkeys for bazaar instasell and instabuy macros for Hypixel Skyblock.
body: QuickBZ is a Fabric mod for Hypixel SkyBlock that lets you bind hotkeys to instant-buy or instant-sell specific Bazaar items. Press a key, the mod opens the Bazaar, navigates to the item, and completes the transaction automatically. Hotkeys are managed through a simple in-game screen accessible via /qbz config or ModMenu.
